details.usageInstructions:
Base Recipe:
Take 3 tbsp (approx. 30g) of this Nutrition Mix powder and add 300ml of water little by little and mix well.
Cook the mixture on a medium flame for 5 minutes.
Keep stirring continuously to avoid lumps.
Adjust the consistency by adding more water if required.
Variations
1. Fruit Punch:
Cut a banana into thin slices.
Blend the above base drink with the Banana slices to make a yummy Banana shake.
Add a little cow milk or coconut milk if required. Kindly avoid Sugar.
Note: Replace Banana with Apple, Raisins or Dates (Soaked in hot water), etc for other yummy flavours.
2. Lemon Blast:
Add a little Lemon juice to the base drink.
Optionally, you can add either Salt or Honey as desired.
